item.title: Top Transfer Defensive End Chaz Coleman Picks Tennessee Over Ohio State
item.description: Ohio State’s bid to land the transfer portal’s top edge rusher has fallen short. Former Penn State defensive end Chaz Coleman, 247Sports’ No. 1-ranked edge rusher in the transfer portal for 2026 and Ohio State’s most high-profile transfer portal target this offseason, committed to Tennessee on Saturday. item.title: Ohio State Transfer Portal Tracker: Ohio State Adds Six Transfers, Loses More Than 25 Players to Transfer Portal
item.description: All of Ohio State's transfer news, all in one place. Welcome to the Eleven Warriors Transfer Portal Tracker, where we’re collecting updates on Ohio State's transfer portal activity this January. Ohio State has added six transfers to its 2026 roster so far: Former Ohio tight end Mason Williams, former UCF long snapper Dalton Riggs and defensive tackle John Walker, former UTSA wide receiver Devin McCuin, former Wisconsin linebacker Christian Alliegro and former Florida State safety Earl Little Jr.

item.title: Ohio State Women’s Basketball Earns Road Win Over No. 8 Maryland, 89-76
item.description: Ohio State women’s basketball earned its biggest win of the season to date at Maryland on Sunday. The Buckeyes earned their first top-10 win of the year as they took down No. 8 Maryland on the road, 89-76, to improve to 15-2 overall on the season and 5-1 in Big Ten play. item.title: Washington Grabs Second-Half Lead, Holds On to Defeat Ohio State, 81-74
item.description: Ohio State had chances, but could not sweep its two-game West Coast road trip. The Buckeyes (11-5, 3-3 Big Ten) fell behind thanks to a 14-0 second-half run by Washington (10-6, 2-3) and dropped an 81-74 game in Seattle. TEAM 1 2 FINAL OHIO STATE 38 36 74 WASHINGTON 36 45 81 Forward Hannes Steinbach and guard Zoom Diallo led the action for Washington, collecting 21 and 20 points, respectively.
